text: Westport Albion advances from their own half on the left side, where Kian Castillo intercepts the ball and quickly passes it forward through a series of short, vertical passes centrally. Near the edge of the six-metre box, Castillo plays a short pass into Rafael Delacroix’s path on the left side inside the penalty area. Delacroix drives forward a few metres and then shoots with his foot into the goal, cutting the score to Kingsmoor FC 2, Westport Albion 1.
